A1.justification: Both complete 18-page PDFs describe the same NavGen, LHPR-VLN and MGDM work. Main text, equations, figures, tables and supplementary Sections 7–9 support reliable comparison; pages 2–18 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original navigation experiments and ablations in Tables 2–4, plus robot-configuration and model/training comparisons in supplementary Tables 6–7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 2–4 and supplementary Tables 6–7, including MGDM evaluations and ablations.

M1.justification: NavGen's generation procedures and MGDM's CoT feedback, short-term memory pooling, long-term retrieval and training objective are unchanged. Supplementary Algorithm 1 is also identical.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same LHPR-VLN multi-stage and step-by-step tasks, HM3D/HSSD scene assets, Habitat/Isaac Sim environments and Spot/Stretch robot coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding tables, including Random, GLM-4v prompt, NaviLLM variants and GPT-4 + NaviLLM. InstructNav already appears in supplementary Tables 6–7 of v1 and remains in v2.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1 and 9.3 retain identical observation and action settings, success criteria, metrics, model configurations and alternating/two-stage training procedures. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The memory and CoT ablations in Table 4, navigation case studies in Figures 5 and 7, and supplementary robot/model/training analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting is retained throughout the experimental tables.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings are identical, including supplementary results. For example, Table 2 retains MGDM's NE 1.23, ISR 4.69, CSR 3.30 and CGT 5.83 for 3–4 subtasks.

T1.justification: The ISR, CSR and CGT definitions and all mathematical formulations in Equations 1–15 are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about the LH-VLN task, NavGen, the 3,260-task LHPR-VLN benchmark, three evaluation metrics and MGDM.

C2.justification: Interpretations of memory benefits, task length and robot configurations are unchanged. Both versions retain the limitation that MGDM struggles to determine whether the target has been reached.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, optimizer information, model-freezing details, trajectory-generation algorithm and prompts are identical. The project link is unchanged; the first-page email edit concerns author contact information.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions, novelty positioning, in-text citations and the complete reference list are identical. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: The first-page author entry changes from Weikai Chen to Vincent Chan, affiliation 2 changes from Tencent America to Independent Researcher, and the associated email changes. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; scientific prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–11 and Tables 1–7 retain identical content, formatting, captions and placement. The page layout is preserved, with only incidental text-width differences from the first-page metadata edits.

improvement.justification: v2 changes only first-page author/contact metadata and the arXiv version stamp. Scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations, reproducibility information and visual presentation are retained, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
